parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return.

parameters.name: DealUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the account that handled the anomalous activity.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The time when the detection of the anomalous activity ended. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the anomalous activity.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the data asset instance.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. The default value is **zh\_cn**. Valid values:

- **zh\_cn**: Chinese.

- **en\_us**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The service to which the data asset belongs. Valid values include MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, and **RDS**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The time when the anomalous activity occurred. This is the start time of the detection. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The processing status of the anomalous activity.

- 0: Unhandled.

- 1: Confirmed.

- 2: Dismissed.

parameters.name: SubTypeCode
parameters.description:
The name of the child type of the anomalous activity.

> To query anomalous activities by the child type name, call the **DescribeEventTypes** operation to get the name.

parameters.name: TargetProductCode
parameters.description: The destination service for an anomalous data flow event. Valid values include MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, and **RDS**.

parameters.name: TypeCode
parameters.description:
The code of the parent type of the anomalous activity.

- 01: Anomalous permission access.

- 02: Anomalous data flow.

- 03: Anomalous data operation.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The ID of the account that performed the operation that triggered the anomalous activity.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The username of the RAM user.

parameters.name: WarnLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level of the anomalous activity.

- **1**: Low.

- **2**: Medium.

- **3**: High.
